description: Fully restores Uptime and clears status. Morale +100.

description: Blocks weaker wild Daemons for 100 steps.

description: Undoes your last few steps and returns you to the entrance of a dungeon.

name: Thumb Drive
description: A basic Quarantine Key. Found in every junk drawer.

description: A Quarantine Key with AES on board. Better odds than a Thumb Drive.

description: A tamper-proof Quarantine Key. High odds.

name: Root Key
description: Full admin access. Quarantines any Daemon, guaranteed.

name: Legacy Driver
description: A driver disk for hardware nobody makes anymore. Upgrades certain Legacy Daemons.
